def control(obs):
    # Look at the reversing camera by default
    look = -41
    status = obs.get('status', '')
    hitch = obs.get('hitch_deg', 0.0)
    max_steer = 42.0
    # If we are pinned, stopped, or jackknifed, drive forward to straighten the trailer
    if status in ('PINNED', 'STOPPED', 'JACKKNIFED'):
        speed = obs['speed']['default_fwd']  # forward ~2.2 m/s
        steer = 0.0
        return steer, speed, look
    # Otherwise we are reversing; steer to reduce hitch angle
    # Positive hitch means trailer swung left, so steer left (positive) to bring it back
    steer = max(min(hitch, max_steer), -max_steer)
    speed = -obs['speed']['default_rev']  # reverse ~-1.3 m/s
    return steer, speed, look
